hyperedges.label: Cloudflare Pages architecture stack (SPA + Hono API + Neon + Access)

nodes.label: Cloudflare Pages Functions (Hono backend)
nodes.rationale: Chosen to run at $0/month, always-on with no cold starts, gated by Cloudflare Access; replaces the Python/FastAPI backend.

nodes.label: Cloudflare Access (site gate)
nodes.rationale: Free email-login gate that protects the whole site.

nodes.label: lib/kv.ts app_config key-value access
nodes.rationale: Mirrors the Python kv.py for app_config key-value access.

nodes.label: Original Python/FastAPI app (reference oracle)
nodes.rationale: Kept runnable as a reference oracle until the TS port is verified route-by-route.

nodes.label: Byte-identical port verification (40 routes)
nodes.rationale: All 40 routes verified byte-identical by running both apps against the same Neon DB and diffing responses; writes verified via snapshot -> run-both -> restore for zero net change.

nodes.label: Summary stat cards convention
nodes.rationale: Center-aligned rounded tinted cards (rounded-2xl border px-5 py-4) with uppercase label, large bold coloured value, optional muted sub-line, applied consistently across all tabs.

nodes.label: Tables convention
nodes.rationale: Edge padding px-6 to align with card title, center-aligned columns except lengthy label columns which stay left-aligned, whole-pound values with a shown GBP sign, reusing shared inline editors.

nodes.label: Budget table ⇄ History table mirror
nodes.rationale: The Dashboard/Budget breakdown table and the History category-breakdown table must stay visually identical on desktop and mobile; any change to one is applied to the other.

nodes.label: Charts convention
nodes.rationale: Every line chart gets a gradient shade; year-to-date is solid+shaded and the projected future is dashed+unshaded; recharts wrapped in ResponsiveContainer width=100%. Tooltips disabled on mobile because on touch they stick open while scrolling and the tables below carry the numbers.

nodes.label: Mobile / responsive conventions
nodes.rationale: Desktop-first with mobile overrides below the md breakpoint (768px); all mobile changes must leave the desktop layout unchanged.

nodes.label: Data tables → stacked cards on mobile
nodes.rationale: Preferred over horizontal scrolling for any table with more than 3 meaningful columns: hide the table with md:block and add a md:hidden card list of label + primary right-aligned stat block plus a 2-column grid of fields.
nodes.norm_label: data tables → stacked cards on mobile

nodes.label: Viewport meta (no input-focus zoom)
nodes.rationale: maximum-scale=1, user-scalable=no prevents iOS from zooming the page when tapping an inline input; ignored on desktop so this is mobile-only.

nodes.label: Dark mode bootstrap class
nodes.rationale: The dark class is added to documentElement inline before render to force dark theme and avoid a light-theme flash.
